summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K carrying five Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns (Exhibits 99.1–99.5) covering open-market repurchases of its WVR ordinary shares (HKEX code 02390) executed between roughly 1 July and mid-September 2026, reported in a series of daily trades at prices near USD 1.04–1.09 per share. The shares were bought for cancellation but not yet cancelled, so they remain in the treasury/cancellation queue rather than reducing issued share count. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or fixed aggregate size is disclosed, and the filing is a routine buyback progress update rather than a change of control or external acquisition. The structural overhang is minimal, with each daily tranche representing roughly 0.03–0.05% of existing issued shares; the risk-arb angle is limited, since the filing is a disclosure of completed micro-buybacks under an ongoing capital-return programme, so watch for continued daily repurchase filings, eventual cancellation confirmation, and any announcement of a formal share buyback mandate or size increase.
